Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary (parent CHEMBL3182437), molecule_hierarchy (all related forms), compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to parent, then molregno to child; compound_records on child molregno; activities on record_id; docs on doc_id; assays on assay_id; target_dictionary on tid; compound_structures on child molregno. Filter: parent chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3182437'; target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3430885'; standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
